_rules: Agents may change only passes, evidence and next_action. Humans add, edit, reorder or remove items.

items.title: Marketplace and all four plugins validate
done_when: claude plugin validate passes for every folder in plugins/

items.title: Audit script is covered by tests
done_when: an empty repo scores 0 and a fully set-up repo scores 80 or more

items.title: Approved criteria are hash-bound to execution evidence
done_when: python3 -m unittest tests.test_harness passes (18 tests, including pinned test files: a weakened test fails check and blocks verify until re-approved)

items.title: Live red team exercises the real tool path
done_when: python3 tools/redteam_live/redteam_live.py --repo . selftest passes (positive and negative control)
python3 -m unittest tests.test_redteam_live passes (parity drift, baseline required, real repo untouched)
python3 tools/redteam_live/redteam_live.py --repo . --config <netns config> selftest reports VERIFIED isolation (Linux)

items.title: Each track runs one real item end to end with a live model
done_when: for each kit track, one work item reaches passes: true with evidence from a real agent run, recorded in progress/progress.md
items.next_action: Run kit track claude-agent-sdk with an API key on a sample repo
